column1: # comment: "GMEOW sign-system \u2192 Glottolog languoid alignments (genealogy/languoid catalog, richer than ISO 639; by reference, curl-validated). A Glottolog languoid names a language variety, a close but not always identical companion to a GMEOW sign system (skos:closeMatch)."

column7: glottolog:stan1293 (Standard English) is Glottolog's languoid for the standard variety; lang:english is the language more broadly, a close but not identical match, so skos:closeMatch.
